stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Michael Leary is the benchmark side this week on 38 pts, everyone else is officially building for next year.

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 103 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 2 off the pace

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Great to see Jordan Simpson make the trip over from North West Bay GC for a hit with us.

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 9 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 16, 17 & 18

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 7 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: The Opportunist
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ from 16 holes - takes the chances when they come

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 9 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Rollercoaster
stories.detail: 3 threes and 5 wipes - never a dull hole

stories.title: Feast or Famine
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers, 4 blanks - no interest in the middle ground

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 17 & 18

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 15, 16 & 17 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: In the Wet
stories.detail: 2.8 soaked the lot of them and the scoreboard has the proof.
